title: Meridian scenario settings
description: Scenario file accepted by meridian run, validate and benchmark. Every field is optional; omitted fields use the documented defaults.

schema_version.description: Settings schema version. Omit it, or give the current version.

scenario_id.description: Portable identifier used in result folder names.

demand_multiplier.description: Positive multiplier applied to demand mean and standard deviation.

service_target.description: Immediate fill-rate target, as a fraction.

stock_multipliers.description: Distinct positive multipliers that build the base-stock candidate grid.
